questions.question: A steady green traffic light means:

options.text: You may go through the intersection if it is safe and clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may go through the intersection if it is safe and clear.
questions.explanation: A green light means you can proceed. Let any traffic or pedestrians already in the intersection pass first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: Why should drivers give extra space to children on bicycles?

options.text: Children do not react as quickly as adults.
Children are smaller and harder to see.

questions.explanation: Children are hard to predict and hard to see. Watch carefully for them near schools, bus stops, playgrounds, and parks. Children on bikes may ride onto the road without warning.

questions.question: What color are temporary work zone signs?
questions.explanation: All temporary work zone signs have orange backgrounds with black writing or symbols.

questions.question: What does a five-sided sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign warns drivers about a school zone. It tells you that children or other pedestrians may be crossing nearby.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a curving road ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming up so you can prepare to stop or turn.

questions.question: If a pedestrian crosses illegally in the middle of the street, you:

options.text: Do not have to stop for them.

questions.explanation: You must stop for all pedestrians. Even if they are crossing where they should not, you still must stop.

questions.question: Which actions are illegal?

options.text: Passing in a marked no passing zone.

questions.explanation: You cannot pass on hills, curves, or where you cannot see far ahead. You cannot pass at street crossings, railroad crossings, in no passing zones, or where there is a solid yellow line on your side. Do not pass in work zones where it is unsafe.

questions.question: What should you do when driving through a work zone?

options.text: Speed up to get through quickly.
Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Slow down when entering a work zone and be prepared to stop. Follow posted speed limits. Watch for workers.

questions.question: Why is night driving harder than day driving?

options.text: Speed limits are higher at night.
Fewer cars are on the road at night.
It is hard to judge distance and speed in the dark.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is hard to judge distance and speed in the dark.
questions.explanation: Night driving is harder because you cannot see as far. Your headlights only light up so much. This makes it difficult to judge how far away other cars are and how fast they are going.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to watch for possible hazards. This sign warns you that a side road will cross ahead.

questions.question: At a crosswalk, what should you do?

options.text: Construction workers must yield to you.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians have the right of way at crosswalks. You must stop for pedestrians in a marked or unmarked crosswalk, even if there is no traffic signal.

questions.question: What commonly causes traffic crashes?

options.text: Speeding and driving too fast for conditions.
Getting enough rest and staying alert.
Watching the road and focusing on driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speeding and driving too fast for conditions.
questions.explanation: Speeding and driving too fast for road conditions are major causes of crashes. Always drive at or below the speed limit and adjust your speed for weather and traffic.

questions.question: You are in an accident with an injury. When must you report it?
questions.explanation: You must call the police immediately if anyone is injured or killed in a crash. Leaving the scene before police arrive is a crime.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: How should you change lanes?

options.text: When a car is in your blind spot.

questions.explanation: Always change lanes slowly and carefully. Only change lanes when needed. Every lane change increases crash risk.

questions.question: If your vehicle has a two-part safety belt, what should you do?

options.text: Use both the lap and shoulder belts.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use both the lap and shoulder belts.
questions.explanation: Always wear both parts of your seat belt. Using only one part greatly reduces your protection. If your shoulder belt is automatic, still buckle your lap belt.

questions.question: What does a red octagon-shaped sign say?
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits turning in the direction shown by the arrow. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a right turn at this intersection.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of colors on a traffic light?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are always arranged with red on top, yellow in the middle, and green on the bottom.

questions.question: When you see someone crossing the street with a white cane or guide dog, you should:

options.text: Stop until the person is well away from your path of travel.
Honk your horn as you proceed past them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop until the person is well away from your path of travel.
questions.explanation: You must stop for pedestrians using a white cane or guide dog. These items show the person is blind. Always give them the right-of-way.

questions.question: Which statement is true about changing lanes?

options.text: You only need to turn and look over your right shoulder for any lane change.
Look over your right shoulder for a right lane change and your left shoulder for a left lane change.
Vehicles with two outside mirrors do not have blind spots.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your right shoulder for a right lane change and your left shoulder for a left lane change.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, signal and look in your mirrors. Then look over your shoulder to check your blind spot. Make sure no vehicle, motorcycle, or bicycle is in the next lane.

questions.question: This bicyclist is signaling:
questions.explanation: Bicycles do not have turn signals. Bicyclists use their left arm held straight out to signal a left turn.

questions.question: When you are behind a motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Be ready to use your horn.

questions.explanation: Stay at least three to four seconds behind a motorcycle. Motorcycles can stop quickly. If the rider falls, you need extra space to avoid them.

questions.question: If there is no crosswalk and a pedestrian is crossing your lane, you should:

options.text: Make sure the pedestrian can see you before proceeding.
Stop and let the pedestrian finish crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let the pedestrian finish crossing.
questions.explanation: Always give pedestrians the right-of-way, even if there is no marked crosswalk.

questions.question: When driving in fog, which headlights should you use?
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog, rain, or snow. High beams reflect off moisture and make it harder to see.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location. You will see this sign where oncoming traffic is a concern.

questions.question: What do "No passing zone" signs tell drivers?

options.text: That it is not safe to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: That it is not safe to pass.
questions.explanation: A "No passing zone" sign means you cannot pass another vehicle in that area. These signs appear where visibility is limited and passing would be unsafe.

questions.question: You are required to stop your vehicle:

options.text: At any intersection where a police officer orders you to stop.
Where there is a red traffic light.

questions.explanation: You must stop at a red traffic light. You must also obey any orders from a police officer directing traffic.
